components.name: Device command executor
components.responsibility: Executes approved device commands in the node agent and publishes truthful results.

components.name: Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery
components.responsibility: Separates running-but-disconnected recovery from stopped-agent recovery and exposes truthful guidance when no supervisor is available.

components.name: Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers
components.responsibility: Publish fresh runtime signals used to derive Online, Offline, Stale, Agent stopped, and Remote access not ready states.

components.name: Lite agent supervisor
components.responsibility: Runs separately from the agent, reads the protected agent environment, and starts or restarts failed agents without overwriting identity.

components.name: Fleet, Apps, Security, Recovery, and Release APIs
components.responsibility: Exposes domain-specific read and command endpoints while preserving backend-owned lifecycle execution.

components.name: Identity, authentication, and invite guards
components.responsibility: Applies identity guards, duplicate checks, protected-host checks, and fail-closed invite/bootstrap acceptance.

components.name: Prepared read, health, readiness, diagnostics, and evidence APIs
components.responsibility: Serves side-effect-free prepared projections, health/readiness, compact diagnostics, and sanitized evidence lookups.

components.name: App Catalog
components.responsibility: Presents backend-owned app lifecycle and safe action readiness, including same-origin Open routes and Manage details.

components.name: App lifecycle worker
components.responsibility: Owns install, repair, media import, backup, restore preview, update readiness/apply, and removal paths only where implemented and safe.

components.name: App backup, restore preview, and update lifecycle
components.responsibility: Coordinates app backup, safe restore preview, update readiness/apply, verification, and rollback gates without browser-owned execution.

components.name: App, command, and workflow state
components.responsibility: Stores canonical app current/action lifecycle and workflow command/current/event state.

components.name: Atomic PWA promotion
components.responsibility: Promotes a verified staged PWA atomically and keeps the previous release available for rollback.

components.name: Backup and verification engine
components.responsibility: Creates and verifies local encrypted backups through backend/worker-owned operations.

components.name: Bounded queues and reconciliation
components.responsibility: Bounds admission, coalesces low-value work, reconciles queue depth, and prevents unrelated lifecycle deletion.

components.name: Browser
components.responsibility: Hosts the installed or web PWA and enforces browser-origin boundaries.

components.name: Caddy same-origin proxy
components.responsibility: Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.

components.name: Checkpoints and retention policy
components.responsibility: Creates pre-change checkpoints and applies explicit bounded retention without silently deleting current state.

components.name: Command admission and lifecycle
components.responsibility: Tracks admission, queued, claimed, running, terminal, acknowledgement, retry, and dead-letter behavior independently from device lifecycle.

components.data_owner: SQLite evidence index and sanitized files
components.name: Completion and audit evidence
components.responsibility: Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.

components.name: Enrollment and device lifecycle state
components.responsibility: Retains enrolled devices across connectivity loss and separates durable enrollment, current state, health, supervisor state, and recovery history.

components.data_owner: FastAPI; Dexie is safe read-only fallback
components.name: Frontend state ownership
components.responsibility: Combines service worker, TanStack Query, Dexie safe snapshots, Zustand UI-only state, XState guided flows, API client, error boundaries, and generated fixtures without owning backend truth.

components.name: GitHub Release
components.responsibility: Publishes the verified Lite release manifest, checksums, and dist.zip assets for the release subprocess.

components.name: GitHub repository
components.responsibility: Hosts source and release workflow definitions; it is not a Lite runtime apply owner.

components.name: Invite and identity lifecycle
components.responsibility: Tracks pending, accepted, revoked, blocked, and consumed invite/identity state with duplicate and mismatch guards.

components.name: Local LAN
components.responsibility: Provides local-device access to the same-origin Caddy endpoint without hardcoded addresses.

components.data_owner: Release SQLite state and prior PWA
components.name: Last-known-good state and rollback
components.responsibility: Records the verified prior release and restores it atomically when post-switch validation fails.

components.name: FastAPI /api/lite/*
components.responsibility: Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.

components.name: Media readiness and app health probes
components.responsibility: Verifies approved media mapping, base-path route health, and app readiness without scanning or exposing user media in documentation.

components.name: NATS / JetStream
components.responsibility: Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.

components.name: Primary and secondary NATS listeners
components.responsibility: Exposes local and verified Tailnet-reachable NATS listeners for agents without hardcoding credentials or addresses.

components.data_owner: Local identity environment; server SQLite is canonical
components.name: Lite node agent
components.responsibility: Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.

components.name: PhotoPrism
components.responsibility: Provides the verified managed photo application under a same-origin Caddy path.

components.name: PM2 process manager
components.responsibility: Starts and supervises approved server-host and joined-device processes with bounded restart policies.

components.name: Post-switch health validation
components.responsibility: Validates Caddy/FastAPI/PWA health after promotion before declaring the release current.

components.name: Audit index, projection refresh, prepared projections, and domain revisions
components.responsibility: Indexes audit evidence and tracks dirty signals, generations, committed projections, current-state summaries, and semantic revisions.

components.name: Projection subprocesses
components.responsibility: Own CPU-heavy projection reconstruction and serialization outside the API process.

components.name: PROot Ubuntu application container
components.responsibility: Hosts verified applications such as PhotoPrism without making documentation tooling or the browser a runtime dependency.

components.name: React / Vite PWA
components.responsibility: Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.

components.name: Backup, restore, and checkpoint state
components.responsibility: Stores backup manifests, recovery operations, current state, database backups/restores, and restore checkpoints.

components.name: Date-based Lite tag, dist.zip, checksums, and release manifest
components.responsibility: Defines immutable release identity and the exact assets required for a Lite installation.

components.data_owner: Staging directory and release SQLite state
components.name: Download staging and release verification
components.responsibility: Downloads on explicit/manual or stable cadence, verifies repository/tag/manifest/assets/checksums, and stages without touching the active PWA.

components.name: Installed release and runtime state
components.responsibility: Stores installed-release identity and release-runtime projection for truthful comparison, staging, apply, rollback, and last-known-good state.

components.data_owner: SQLite release state and staging area
components.name: Release subprocess
components.responsibility: Owns network, download, verification, staging, apply, and rollback work outside the FastAPI event loop.

components.name: Remote-access readiness checks
components.responsibility: Combines tailscaled state, Tailnet IPv4, NATS listener reachability, agent/supervisor status, and safe guidance.

components.name: Restore preview and confirmed restore
components.responsibility: Builds a non-destructive preview, requires explicit confirmation, creates a checkpoint, applies restore, and validates health.

components.name: Explicit retirement and database recovery
components.responsibility: Requires assessment and confirmation for device retirement and provides verified database backup/preview/restore without coupling command cleanup to device deletion.

components.name: Lynis and Trivy scanner adapters
components.responsibility: Run bounded backend-owned scanners with target-aware exclusions and sanitized evidence; the browser never executes scanners.

components.name: Security scan coordinator
components.responsibility: Validates Quick, Full, and App Check requests, tracks active runs, and exposes compact split-read summaries.

components.name: Quick, Full, and App safety checks
components.responsibility: Defines bounded profile-specific targets, exclusions, timeouts, coverage summaries, and truthful partial/failed states.

components.name: Security findings and run state
components.responsibility: Stores scan runs, tools, progress, findings, profile snapshots, and sanitized evidence references.

components.name: SQLite control-plane store
components.responsibility: Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.

components.name: Tailscale remote access
components.responsibility: Provides private Tailnet connectivity and HTTPS identity without becoming a browser-held secret or control owner.

components.name: tailscaled daemon
components.responsibility: Owns Tailscale networking; startup scripts may detect/start it safely while read APIs remain side-effect-free.

components.name: User
components.responsibility: Uses Pocket Lab Lite through the browser.

components.name: Worker process
components.responsibility: Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.

components.name: Workflow execution
components.responsibility: Coordinates multi-step workflow state through bounded event admission and process-isolated projection work.

operational_guarantees: Frontend never talks directly to NATS.
Agents and supervisors own execution and recovery.
Startup scripts own safe startup side effects.
